","type":"text/x-markdown","caption":"work focus"},"/home/runner/work/tw-plugin-library/tw-plugin-library/wiki/plugins/rimir/work-focus/README.md":{"title":"/home/runner/work/tw-plugin-library/tw-plugin-library/wiki/plugins/rimir/work-focus/README.md","text":"# Work focus A small dock in a corner of the page shows how many things need you: overdue, due today, newly started. Open it to see the items. Drag one to the side and a ring of action tiles appears; release on a tile to act on the item without opening it. ## Features - **Dock** — a pill strip with one count per area (alert, warning, hint). It refreshes on reload, on ↻, after an action and when an edit is saved (closing an area card, leaving edit mode, the Save of a form), never while you type. - **Panel** — click the dock to list the items by area, with tabs, "+ N more", and info lines such as "overdue 3d" or "changed 2d ago". - **Areas are your filters** — an area is a config tiddler with a filter; first match wins, so an item shows in one area only. - **Drag ring** — drag a row to the right: a half ring of groups (Move, Mute, Status, Open, …) opens; hover a group to fan out its tiles (Today, Tmrw, the next weekdays, +1 wk); release to run. - **Acted marks** — an item you acted on stays in the panel with a mark ("→ Mon 9") until the next check. - **Mutes** — hide an item until a day; it shows again then. Unmute from the panel footer. - **Recipes** — an action is a config tiddler: pick a recipe (move a date, set a field, tag, create, open, mute) or write your own action string. - **Edit mode** — press ✎ in the panel header: area cards with a live match count, tabs, drag reorder; forms for actions and groups, also from the ring (drag in edit mode: ✎ on a tile; the form opens next to it) and from the settings tab. An action's tiles (e.g. the days of Move) are chips in its form: add, remove, reorder, rename. - **Generic** — no hard dependency on any other plugin; the example areas live in your wiki, not in the plugin. ## Prerequisites - TiddlyWiki 5.4.0 or later (JS modules: server restart or reload needed after install) - Optional: `rimir/theme` (`rr-` styles in settings), `rimir/doc-template` (branded docs) ## Quick Start 1. Install the plugin and restart the server: its JS modules (check, ring, date operators, `live-filter.js`, `live-widget.js`, `datalist.js`) load only at startup. A single-file wiki: save and reload. 2. Create an area tiddler, tagged `$:/tags/rimir/work-focus/area`, with fields `caption: Overdue`, `wf.level: alert`, `wf.date-field: due-date`, `wf.info: date-relative` and the filter `wf.filter: [has[due-date]!has[completed-date]] :filter[get[due-date]wf-days[]compare:integer:lt[0]]`. 3. Reload the page. The dock shows a red pill with the number of overdue items (no pill when nothing is overdue). Click it to see the items. 4. Press on a row, drag to the right, hover *Move*, release on *Tmrw*. 5. Press ✎ in the panel header to edit areas, actions and groups without writing tiddlers. Esc leaves edit mode. Returns {list, error}: error is the message when the filter threw // or reported a runtime error ("Filter error: ..." / "Filter Error: ..."), list is then empty. exports.runFilter = function(wiki, filter, widget, source) { var list; try { list = wiki.filterTiddlers(filter, widget, source); } catch(e) { return {list: [], error: String(e && e.message || e)}; } if(list.length && /^filter error:/i.test(String(list[0]))) { return {list: [], error: String(list[0])}; } return {list: list, error: null}; }; // Mutes still in force: value is a day after today. exports.activeMutes = function(wiki, now) { var data = wiki.getTiddlerData(MUTES, {}), result = {}; Object.keys(data).forEach(function(item) { var days = dates.daysFrom(data[item], now); if(days !== null && days > 0) { result[item] = String(data[item]).trim(); } }); return result; }; exports.compute = function(wiki, now) { var mutes = exports.activeMutes(wiki, now), snapshot = {checked: $tw.utils.stringifyDate(now), areas: {}, muted: [], errors: {}}, claimed = Object.create(null), widget = exports.globalWidget(wiki); exports.areas(wiki).forEach(function(area) { var filter = wiki.getTiddler(area).fields["wf.filter"] || "", found = [], result = exports.runFilter(wiki, filter, widget); if(result.error) { snapshot.errors[area] = result.error; } result.list.forEach(function(item) { var tiddler = wiki.getTiddler(item); if(tiddler && tiddler.fields["draft.of"]) { // a draft is never an item return; } if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(mutes, item)) { if(snapshot.muted.indexOf(item) === -1) { snapshot.muted.push(item); } } else if(!claimed[item]) { claimed[item] = true; found.push(item); } }); snapshot.areas[area] = found; }); return snapshot; }; exports.write = function(wiki, now, opts) { opts = opts || {}; var data = wiki.getTiddlerData(MUTES, null), active; if(data) { active = exports.activeMutes(wiki, now); if(Object.keys(active).length !== Object.keys(data).length) { wiki.setTiddlerData(MUTES, active); } } var snapshot = exports.compute(wiki, now); wiki.setTiddlerData(SNAPSHOT, snapshot); if(opts.clearActed) { wiki.deleteTiddler(ACTED); } if(opts.acted) { var acted = wiki.getTiddlerData(ACTED, {}); acted[opts.acted.item] = {area: opts.acted.area, mark: opts.acted.mark}; wiki.setTiddlerData(ACTED, acted); Clicks in the edit form (.wf-form) and on the ring (.wf-ring) count as inside. \*/ "use strict"; var OPEN = "$:/temp/rimir/work-focus/open"; exports.name = "work-focus-click-outside"; exports.platforms = ["browser"]; exports.after = ["startup"]; exports.synchronous = true; exports.startup = function() { // capture phase: runs even if a handler underneath stops propagation document.addEventListener("click", function(event) { var target = event.target; if($tw.wiki.getTiddlerText(OPEN) !== "yes" || (target && target.closest && target.closest(".wf-dock, .wf-panel, .wf-form, .wf-ring"))) { return; } $tw.wiki.deleteTiddler(OPEN); }, true); }; ","type":"application/javascript","module-type":"startup"},"$:/config/rimir/work-focus/date-format":{"title":"$:/config/rimir/work-focus/date-format","text":"YYYY0MM0DD "},"$:/config/rimir/work-focus/enabled":{"title":"$:/config/rimir/work-focus/enabled","text":"yes "},"$:/config/rimir/work-focus/position":{"title":"$:/config/rimir/work-focus/position","text":"top-left "},"$:/config/rimir/work-focus/section-limit":{"title":"$:/config/rimir/work-focus/section-limit","text":"5 "},"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/datalist.js":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/datalist.js","text":"/*\ title: $:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/datalist.js type: application/javascript module-type: startup Edit mode: <$edit-text> can't set an input's `list` attribute, so inputs with the class `wf-fields-input` get list="wf-fields" (the field names of the live matches, area-card.tid), and inputs with a class `wf-list-` get list="" (form.tid, action-form.tid), when they take the focus. \*/ "use strict"; exports.name = "work-focus-datalist"; exports.platforms = ["browser"]; exports.after = ["startup"]; exports.synchronous = true; exports.startup = function() { document.addEventListener("focusin", function(event) { var target = event.target, match; if(!target || !target.classList || target.getAttribute("list")) { return; } if(target.classList.contains("wf-fields-input")) { target.setAttribute("list", "wf-fields"); } else if(typeof target.className === "string" && (match =/(?:^|\s)wf-list-(\S+)/.exec(target.className))) { target.setAttribute("list", match[1]); } }, true); }; ","type":"application/javascript","module-type":"startup"},"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/date-operators.js":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/date-operators.js","text":"/*\ title: $:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/date-operators.js type: application/javascript module-type: filteroperator Filter operators wf-date and wf-days. [wf-date[],[]] one date string (empty when expr is unknown) [wf-days[]] whole days from today per input; unparsable dropped \*/ "use strict"; var dates = require("$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/dates.js"); exports["wf-date"] = function(source, operator, options) { var d = dates.resolve(operator.operands && operator.operands.length ? operator.operands[0] : operator.operand, new Date()); return d ? [dates.format(d, operator.operands ? operator.operands[1] : "", options.wiki)] : []; }; exports["wf-days"] = function(source, operator, options) { var results = [], now = new Date(); source(function(tiddler, title) { var n = dates.daysFrom(title, now); if(n !== null) { results.push(String(n)); } }); return results; }; ","type":"application/javascript","module-type":"filteroperator"},"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/dates.js":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/dates.js","text":"/*\ title: $:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/dates.js type: application/javascript module-type: library Date helpers for work-focus: date expressions, formatting, day differences. All dates are local calendar days; TW 14/17-digit values are UTC instants. \*/ "use strict"; var DAYS = ["sun", "mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri", "sat"]; var CONFIG_FORMAT = "$:/config/rimir/work-focus/date-format"; var DEFAULT_FORMAT = "YYYY0MM0DD"; var TW_FORMAT = "[UTC]YYYY0MM0DD0hh0mm0ss0XXX"; function midnight(date) { return new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate()); } function addDays(date, n) { return new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate() + n); } function pad(n, len) { var s = String(n); while(s.length < len) { s = "0" + s; } return s; } // Local calendar day of a value: Date (local midnight) or null. function dayOf(value) { var v = String(value === undefined || value === null ? "" : value).trim(), d; if(/^\d{8}$/.test(v)) { d = new Date(+v.slice(0, 4), +v.slice(4, 6) - 1, +v.slice(6, 8)); // reject overflowed dates such as 20261340 if(d.getFullYear() !== +v.slice(0, 4) || d.getMonth() !== +v.slice(4, 6) - 1 || d.getDate() !== +v.slice(6, 8)) { return null; } return d; } if(/^(\d{14}|\d{17})$/.test(v)) { d = $tw.utils.parseDate(v); return d && !isNaN(d.getTime()) ? midnight(d) : null; } return null; } // expr: today | +Nd | -Nd | +Nw | mon..sun (next such day, never today) | YYYYMMDD exports.resolve = function(expr, now) { var e = String(expr === undefined || expr === null ? "" : expr).trim().toLowerCase(), m, today = midnight(now), delta; if(e === "today") { return today; } m = /^([+-])(\d+)([dw])$/.exec(e); if(m) { return addDays(today, (m[1] === "-" ? -1 : 1) * (+m[2]) * (m[3] === "w" ? 7 : 1)); } m = DAYS.indexOf(e); if(m >= 0) { delta = (m - today.getDay() + 7) % 7; return addDays(today, delta === 0 ? 7 : delta); } if(/^\d{8}$/.test(e)) { return dayOf(e); } return null; }; // Format date in the shape of sample (8 digits: YYYYMMDD; 14/17 digits: TW date; else config format). exports.format = function(date, sample, wiki) { var s = String(sample === undefined || sample === null ? "" : sample).trim(), fmt; if(/^\d{8}$/.test(s)) { return pad(date.getFullYear(), 4) + pad(date.getMonth() + 1, 2) + pad(date.getDate(), 2); } if(/^(\d{14}|\d{17})$/.test(s)) { return $tw.utils.formatDateString(date, TW_FORMAT); } fmt = ((wiki || $tw.wiki).getTiddlerText(CONFIG_FORMAT) || "").trim() || DEFAULT_FORMAT; return $tw.utils.formatDateString(date, fmt); }; // Whole days from local today to the value's calendar day; null if unparsable. exports.daysFrom = function(value, now) { var d = dayOf(value), t = midnight(now); if(!d) { return null; } return Math.round((Date.UTC(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate()) - Date.UTC(t.getFullYear(), t.getMonth(), t.getDate())) / 86400000); }; ","type":"application/javascript","module-type":"library"},"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/doc/architecture":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/doc/architecture","created":"20261106120000000","modified":"20261106120000000","rdt.hub-category":"tools","rdt.hub-category-name":"Tools","rdt.hub-order":"5","rdt.order":"2","rdt.plugin-key":"work-focus","rdt.plugin-name":"work focus","rdt.plugin-subtitle":"Dock with attention counts and a drag action ring","rdt.section":"Architecture","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template/templates/page"> <$fill $name="body"> !! Pieces |!Piece |!What it does | |`dates.js`, `date-operators.js` |Date expressions (`today`, `+1d`, `mon`, …), formatting, day differences. Filter operators `wf-date` and `wf-days` | |`check.js`, `action-wf-check.js` |Runs every area filter once (first match wins), applies mutes, writes the snapshot. `<$action-wf-check/>`. Also the shared filter helpers: `runFilter` (a throw or a `Filter Error: …` result is an error, never an item) and `globalWidget`/`importWidget` (filters run under `\import [subfilter{$:/core/config/GlobalImportFilter}]`, like the page template) | |`startup-check.tid` |Check on reload (`$:/tags/StartupAction/Browser`) | |`actions.js` |Which tiles and groups the ring shows for one item (filters see the global and the engine functions); builds and runs an action (`wf.requires` checked first) | |`ring-layer.js`, `ring-geometry.js` |The pointer gesture and the ring: plain DOM, laid out once per arc | |`click-outside.js` |Startup module: a click outside dock and panel closes the panel | |`engine.tid` |Shared `\function`s and `\procedure`s for dock, panel and item | |`layer.tid`, `dock.tid`, `panel.tid`, `item.tid` |Page template layer, closed strip, open panel, one row | |`edit-engine.tid` |Edit mode `\function`s and `\procedure`s: slugs, tag lists that skip the form buffer (`wf.tagged`, `wf.actions-all`, `wf.groups-all`, `wf.recipes-all`), area and tab operations, form open/save/duplicate/delete/close, `wf-escape` | |`edit-panel.tid`, `area-card.tid` |Edit mode body of the panel: tabs, area cards with inline forms | |`form.tid`, `action-form.tid`, `group-form.tid`, `info-picker.tid` |The floating form host (rendered by `layer.tid` while the form state exists), the two forms and the `wf.info` editor | |`recipes//form.tid` |One form per shipped recipe | |`live-filter.js`, `live-widget.js` |`<$wf-live>`: a filter evaluated once at render and, debounced 300 ms, when its text changes; never on other wiki changes | |`datalist.js` |Startup module: adds `list=` to field-name inputs when they take the focus | |`styles.tid`, `config/*`, `info/*`, `recipes/*`, `groups/*`, `actions/*` |Styles, defaults, shipped parts | !! Data flow # A check runs the area filters in tag order. An item goes to the first area that matches. Muted items go to the muted list. # The result is one JSON tiddler, the //snapshot// (`$:/temp/rimir/work-focus/snapshot`). Dock and panel only read it. # A drag asks `actions.select` for the ring: every action whose filter returns something for this item, grouped by `wf.group`. # A release runs the action string with the item's variables, then writes an //acted mark// and checks again. !! State tiddlers |!Tiddler |!Content | |`$:/temp/rimir/work-focus/snapshot` |`{"checked", "areas": {area: [items]}, "muted": [items], "errors": {area: message}}` | |`$:/temp/rimir/work-focus/acted` |`{item: {"area", "mark"}}`; cleared by a reload or ↻ | |`$:/rimir/work-focus/mutes` |`{item: "YYYYMMDD"}`, saved with the wiki (not under `$:/state/`, which TW does not sync): the day the item shows again | |`$:/temp/rimir/work-focus/open` |`yes` while the panel is open | |`$:/temp/rimir/work-focus/more/` |`yes` after "+ N more" was clicked | |`$:/temp/rimir/work-focus/show-muted` |`yes` while the muted list is shown | |`$:/state/rimir/work-focus/tab` |The active tab (per session; not saved) | |`$:/temp/rimir/work-focus/edit` |`yes` while the panel is in edit mode | |`$:/temp/rimir/work-focus/edit-view` |`areas` (default) or `actions` | |`$:/temp/rimir/work-focus/edit-area` |The area whose card is open | |`$:/temp/rimir/work-focus/form` |Form state: `kind` (`action` or `group`), `target` (blank = new), `item`, `area`, `side` (`left` or `right`), `value` (the tile clicked in the ring, highlighted in the tiles editor), `left`/`top` (px, set by the ring: the form sits next to it; blank = at the window edge of `side`) | |`$:/temp/rimir/work-focus/form/buffer` |The copy the form edits. The transient field `wf-form.default` is applied and removed on Save | |`$:/temp/rimir/work-focus/form/tiles`, `…/form/tile-label` |Tiles editor inputs (add row; the label being edited with its old value) | |`$:/temp/rimir/work-focus/confirm` |The second click of a delete | !! Edit mode * ''Areas'' edit the area tiddler in place. The card's count is the raw filter count from `<$wf-live>`: no first-match placement, drafts counted, so it can be higher than the dock chip. * ''Actions and groups'' edit a copy. `wf-form-open` reads the variables `kind`, `target`, `item`, `area`, `preset` (a JSON string of fields for a new one) and `side`, writes the form state and fills the buffer. Save writes the tiddler (`$action-createtiddler … $overwrite`) and closes the form; closing otherwise writes nothing. * ''Delete'' on a shipped action or group sets `wf.hidden: yes` (hidden, not gone); "↺ Shipped" in the form removes the override and restores the shipped one. A new one is deleted for real. * ''Switching the recipe'' keeps the old recipe's `wf.*` fields in the tiddler. * ''Default of group'' (action form) can only set a default; clear it in the group form. * ''Replaces'' edits one title, although `wf.replaces` may be a list. * ''Recipe forms'': `/form` is rendered with `currentTiddler` = the buffer and the variables `item`, `area`, `date-field`. A bridge plugin adds a form for its own recipe by shipping that tiddler. * ''Ring in edit mode'': pinned after release, ✎ badges, "+ group" and "+ add…", hidden actions dimmed. While a form is open hovering does not fan or close arcs (a click does). The ring rebuilds after a save. The 6 group cap with "⋯ More" applies in edit mode too. !! Limits built in At most 6 groups on the first ring (the rest under "⋯ More") and 3 levels of nesting. Tests ``` bin/tw test work-focus # Jasmine: dates, check, actions, run, ring geometry bin/tw test:e2e work-focus # Playwright: dock, panel, drag, ring, mutes ``` !! Adding a recipe, group or action # Create a tiddler with the right tag (see //Reference//). Use the same title as a shipped one to override it. # Reload. The next drag shows it. Edit mode * A bridge ships `/form` to give its recipe a form; no JS, no restart. * Use `wf.tagged`, `wf.actions-all`, `wf.groups-all`, `wf.recipes-all` for tag lists: they leave out the form buffer. * The Playwright specs for edit mode clean up the config tiddlers they create (`areas/`, `actions/`, `groups/`) and the edit state. !! An overdue area ``` title: $:/config/rimir/work-focus/areas/overdue tags: $:/tags/rimir/work-focus/area caption: Overdue wf.level: alert wf.date-field: due-date wf.info: date-relative field:parent wf.when-past: overdue <>d wf.filter: [has[due-date]!has[completed-date]] :filter[get[due-date]wf-days[]compare:integer:lt[0]] ``` `wf.info` lists the parts shown under each item: `date-relative`, `date-relative:` (another date field, worded by `wf.when-past.` etc., e.g. `wf.when-future.due-date: due in <>d`), `modified-ago` and `field:`. Several areas can share a tab (`wf.tab`). !! Status area and a "Done" action An action that only exists where it makes sense. `` is the area tiddler's title. ``` title: $:/config/rimir/work-focus/actions/done tags: $:/tags/rimir/work-focus/action caption: Done wf.group: status wf.icon: ✓ wf.filter: [!match[$:/config/rimir/work-focus/areas/plan]] wf.mark: ✓ done <$action-setfield $tiddler=<> completed-date={{{ [wf-date[today]] }}}/> ``` !! Your own tiles Tile values come from `wf.tiles`, a filter. Values with `+` or `-` must be bracketed. ``` wf.tiles: [[today]] [[+1d]] [[+2d]] [[+3d]] [[+4d]] [[+1w]] ``` !! Set a field with the shipped recipe ``` title: $:/config/rimir/work-focus/actions/waiting tags: $:/tags/rimir/work-focus/action caption: Waiting wf.group: status wf.recipe: set-field wf.field: status wf.value: waiting ``` !! A recipe form for your own recipe A bridge plugin that ships a recipe `$:/plugins/me/bridge/recipes/ping` adds its settings by shipping `$:/plugins/me/bridge/recipes/ping/form`. Rendered with `currentTiddler` = the buffer: ``` title: $:/plugins/me/bridge/recipes/ping/form ``` !! Edit instead of writing tiddlers Press ✎ in the panel header, open the card of an area and type a filter: the count under it follows after a short pause. In the Actions view drag a row and release: the ring stays pinned, and a click on a tile (or its ✎) opens the action form. The settings tab opens the same form, also for a new action ("+ action"). Fill the label, group and recipe, press Save. !! Replace a shipped action Make a tiddler with the same title as the shipped one, e.g. `$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/actions/day-strip`. Yours wins over the plugin's shadow. To hide one, set `wf.hidden: yes`; to replace it by another action, name it in that action's `wf.replaces`. "},"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/doc/faq":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/doc/faq","created":"20261106120000000","modified":"20261106120000000","rdt.hub-category":"tools","rdt.hub-category-name":"Tools","rdt.hub-order":"5","rdt.order":"5","rdt.plugin-key":"work-focus","rdt.plugin-name":"work focus","rdt.plugin-subtitle":"Dock with attention counts and a drag action ring","rdt.section":"FAQ","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template/templates/page"> <$fill $name="body"> !! Q: I changed a date and the count did not change. The counts are a snapshot. It refreshes on reload, on ↻, after an action and when an edit is saved: closing an area card, leaving edit mode, Save/Duplicate/Delete in a form, "+ area", "+ tab", rename, move, delete. Nothing runs while you type: edit a tiddler (a date, a status) and the counts stay until you click ↻. !! Q: An item I expected is missing. It may sit in an earlier area (first match wins), be muted (see the footer of the panel), or have a blank or non-date value in the area's date field (`wf-days` drops those). !! Q: The dock shows `!`. The area filter is broken. Hover the `!` to see the error. The other areas still work. !! Q: I drag a row and no ring opens. No action matched this item. An action needs `wf.group`, and its `wf.filter` must return something for the item. Without a filter it always matches. !! Q: An action has no tile for a value like `+1d`. Values with `+` or `-` must be bracketed in `wf.tiles`: `[[today]] [[+1d]]`. !! Q: The action failed halfway; is it undone? No. Actions are not transactional. A failing action shows a notice and leaves no mark, but what it changed before the failure stays. !! Q: I defined a group or action twice. With the same `wf.name` (group or recipe) the first one found wins. To override a shipped one, use the same //title// as the shadow; your tiddler then replaces it. !! Q: Move does the wrong default. A group's default tile is the group's `wf.default` action. When it has several tiles, `wf.default-value` picks one. Move uses the day strip's `+1d` (Tmrw). The day strip rolls forward from today (Today, Tmrw, then the next three weekdays, then +1 wk), so on a Sunday it reads Today, Tmrw (Mon), Tue, Wed, Thu, +1 wk. !! Q: Does clicking an item close the panel? No, so you can triage several. A click outside closes it, and that click still reaches what is underneath. !! Q: I installed it and nothing changed. JS modules need a server restart (`click-outside.js`, `ring-layer.js`, `date-operators.js`, `live-filter.js`, `live-widget.js`, `datalist.js`, …). !! Q: The dock is hidden behind the sidebar button. At `top-right` it can sit under the Vanilla sidebar toggle. Use another corner or move the dock. !! Q: Tiles are cut off on a small window. With 5 or 6 groups, a viewport of about 440 px height or less can clamp tiles. Use a taller window. !! Q: The card says 12 but the dock chip says 9. The card count is the raw filter count: no first-match placement (an earlier area may claim an item), drafts counted. The dock shows the snapshot after the checks. !! Q: I dropped a card outside the panel and TiddlyWiki opened its import dialog. Cards are draggable tiddlers; dropping one on the page is an import. Cancel the dialog. Drop cards on a tab, on another card or on "+ area". !! Q: Where is the Save button of an area? There is none. A card edits the area tiddler directly. Actions and groups use a form with Save, which edits a copy. !! Q: I deleted a shipped action and it is still listed. Delete on a shipped action or group hides it (`wf.hidden: yes`). Open it from the settings tab or the ring (hidden tiles are dimmed) and press "↺ Shipped" to restore it. !! Q: I switched the recipe and old fields remain. Switching keeps the previous recipe's `wf.*` fields in the tiddler, so switching back loses nothing. Remove them in the tiddler editor if you want it clean. !! Q: How do I clear the default of a group? "Default of group" in the action form can only set one. Clear it in the group form. !! Q: Replaces shows one title but `wf.replaces` has several. The form edits a single title. Edit the field in the tiddler editor for a list. !! Q: Esc does not close the panel. Esc steps back in this order: menu, form, pinned ring, open card, edit mode, panel. Press it again. !! Q: The ring stays open after I release. In edit mode the ring is pinned. Esc, a click outside, or leaving edit mode closes it. "},"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/doc/overview":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/doc/overview","created":"20261106120000000","modified":"20261106120000000","rdt.hub-category":"tools","rdt.hub-category-name":"Tools","rdt.hub-order":"5","rdt.order":"1","rdt.plugin-key":"work-focus","rdt.plugin-name":"work focus","rdt.plugin-subtitle":"Dock with attention counts and a drag action ring","rdt.section":"Overview","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template/templates/page"> <$fill $name="body"> !! What it does A dock in a corner of the page shows how many things need you. Each count is an //area//: a config tiddler with a filter, for example "tasks overdue", "due today", "started". Click the dock and a panel lists the items. Press an item and drag it sideways: a half ring of action tiles opens. Hover a group (Move, Mute, Status, …) to fan out its tiles, release on one to run it. The item is not opened. The plugin knows nothing about your data. Areas, extra actions and extra groups are config tiddlers in your wiki. !! How you use it # The dock shows one pill per area that has items (alert, then warning, then hint) and the time of the last check. ↻ checks again, and so does every save in edit mode. # Click the dock: the panel opens. Tabs appear when areas name different tabs. An area shows 5 items, then "+ N more". # Click an item to open it. The panel stays open, so you can triage. # Press an item, drag more than 5 pixels (touch: hold 400 ms, then drag). The ring opens on the side of the panel that faces free space. # Hover a group for 150 ms: its tiles fan out. Release on a tile to run it, or on a group to run its default tile. Esc, release elsewhere, or losing the window cancels. # The item stays in the panel with a mark ("→ Mon 9", "🔕 until Mon 9") until the next check. # Click outside the panel to close it. Esc closes it too. !! Edit mode Press ✎ in the panel header. The panel switches to edit mode with an //Areas | Actions// switch. * ''Areas'' — one card per area, grouped by tab. A card edits the area tiddler directly (no Save): caption, level, date field, info parts and the filter, with a live match count. "+ area", "+ tab", ✎ on a tab renames it, drag a card to reorder or to another tab, delete asks twice. * ''Actions'' — the item list of the normal panel. Drag a row to pin its ring, then click a tile or its ✎ to open the action or group form beside the ring. The settings tab has the same forms with "+ action" and "+ group". * ''The ring'' — drag a row in edit mode: the ring stays pinned after release, tiles carry a ✎ badge, "+ group" and "+ add…" create new ones. * ''Esc'' steps back in this order: menu, form, pinned ring, open card, edit mode, panel. "Done editing" leaves edit mode too. The settings tab lists areas, groups and actions with the same editors. !! Counts are a snapshot The area filters run on reload, on ↻, after an action and at the save points of edit mode: closing an area card (header, Done, Esc, opening another card, switching view or tab), leaving edit mode, "+ area", "+ tab", rename, move, delete, and Save/Duplicate/Delete/"↺ Shipped" in an action or group form. They never run per keystroke, so the dock costs nothing while you type. Edit a date in an ordinary tiddler and the counts stay until you check again. The live count on an area card in edit mode (see //Architecture//) follows the filter text while you type; the dock follows when you close the card. !! Where the configuration lives |!What |!Where | |Areas |tiddlers tagged `$:/tags/rimir/work-focus/area` | |Groups of the ring |tag `$:/tags/rimir/work-focus/group` | |Actions (tiles) |tag `$:/tags/rimir/work-focus/action` | |Recipes (action templates) |tag `$:/tags/rimir/work-focus/recipe` | |Info parts (lines under an item) |tag `$:/tags/rimir/work-focus/info-part` | |Settings |`$:/config/rimir/work-focus/*` (see the settings tab) | See //Reference// for every field and //Examples// for ready configurations. "},"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/doc/reference":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/doc/reference","created":"20261106120000000","modified":"20261106120000000","rdt.hub-category":"tools","rdt.hub-category-name":"Tools","rdt.hub-order":"5","rdt.order":"6","rdt.plugin-key":"work-focus","rdt.plugin-name":"work focus","rdt.plugin-subtitle":"Dock with attention counts and a drag action ring","rdt.section":"Reference","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template/templates/page"> <$fill $name="body"> !! Configuration |!Tiddler |!Default |!Meaning | |`$:/config/rimir/work-focus/enabled` |`yes` |`no` removes the dock and the ring | |`$:/config/rimir/work-focus/position` |`top-left` |`top-left`, `top-right`, `bottom-left`, `bottom-right` | |`$:/config/rimir/work-focus/date-format` |`YYYY0MM0DD` |Format `wf-date` writes when the field has no sample value. A field that already holds 8 digits or a TW date keeps its shape | |`$:/config/rimir/work-focus/section-limit` |`5` |Items per area before "+ N more" | !! Area (tag `$:/tags/rimir/work-focus/area`) Order = tag order. The first area whose filter returns an item claims it. Drafts are never areas or items. Area filters see the global functions and macros (`$:/tags/Global`, `$:/tags/Macro`), as on the page. A filter that throws or reports `Filter Error: …` shows `!` with the message as tooltip. |!Field |!Meaning | |`caption` |Name in dock tooltip and panel | |`wf.filter` |Filter returning the item titles | |`wf.level` |`alert`, `warning` or `hint` (default `hint`). Dock order: alert, warning, hint | |`wf.date-field` |Field the info parts and date actions use (variable `date-field`) | |`wf.tab` |Tab name; blank = "General" | |`wf.info` |Space separated parts: `date-relative`, `date-relative:`, `modified-ago`, `field:` | |`wf.when-past`, `wf.when-today`, `wf.when-future` |Wikitext for `date-relative`; `<>` = number of days. Defaults `<>d ago`, `today`, `in <>d` | |`wf.when-past.`, `wf.when-today.`, `wf.when-future.` |Wording for `date-relative:` (e.g. `wf.when-future.due-date: due in <>d`); same defaults | !! Group (tag `$:/tags/rimir/work-focus/group`) |!Field |!Meaning | |`wf.name` |Key that actions name in `wf.group`. The first group with a name wins | |`caption`, `wf.icon`, `wf.order` |Label, icon, sort order | |`wf.parent` |Name of the parent group (3 levels at most) | |`wf.default` |Action run when you release on the group itself | |`wf.default-value` |Tile value of that action to run (Move: `+1d`) | Shipped groups: `move`, `mute`, `status`, `create`, `open`. A group without tiles is not shown (edit mode shows it; `create` has no shipped action). !! Action (tag `$:/tags/rimir/work-focus/action`) |!Field |!Meaning | |`caption`, `wf.icon`, `wf.order` |Tile text, icon, order | |`wf.group` |Group name. ''Without it the action is not shown'' | |`wf.filter` |The action applies when the result is ''non-empty''. Source = the item. A broken filter (or `Filter Error: …`) means no match. Blank = always | |`wf.recipe` |Recipe name. Blank: the tiddler's text is the action string | |`wf.tiles` |Filter giving tile values (one tile each). Bracket `+`/`-`: `[[today]] [[+1d]]`. `[function[wf.distinct-days],[today +1d mon]]` drops a date expression that falls on an earlier one's day | |`wf.tile-label`, `wf.tile-sub` |Wikitext for a tile's label and sub line (`<>`) | |`wf.tile-labels` |JSON object `{"value": "label"}`: a tile's own label, before `wf.tile-label` (blank = the template). Written by the form's tiles editor | |`wf.hint` |Wikitext shown while hovering a tile; blank: the recipe's | |`wf.mark` |Wikitext for the acted mark; blank: the recipe's, then the tile caption | |`wf.no-mark` |`yes`: no mark (Open) | |`wf.hidden` |`yes`: not shown outside edit mode (dimmed in edit mode) | |`wf.replaces` |Titles of actions this one hides while it matches | |`wf.requires` |Filter (engine functions available) whose first value must be non-blank, else nothing runs: no mark, no check, notification `wf.requires-message` (default "Nothing to do"). Blank: the recipe's | |recipe parameters |`wf.field`, `wf.to`, `wf.until`, `wf.value`, `wf.title`, `wf.fields`, `wf.tag`, `wf.mode` — see the recipes | Variables in filters, hints, marks, tile labels and action strings: `item`, `area`, `date-field`, `value`, `action`; `currentTiddler` = `item`. They also see the global functions and macros and the `wf.*` engine functions. Draft actions, groups and recipes are ignored. !! Recipe (tag `$:/tags/rimir/work-focus/recipe`) `wf.name`, `caption`, `wf.mark`, `wf.hint`, `wf.deferred` (`yes`: the action sets its own mark later), `wf.requires` / `wf.requires-message` (see Action), text = the action string. |!Shipped |!Parameters | |`move-date` |`wf.field` (default: the area's date field), `wf.to` (default: the tile value). No field: fails with "no field to set" | |`mute` |`wf.until` (default: the tile value) | |`open` |none | |`set-field` |`wf.field`, `wf.value`. Blank `wf.field`: fails with "no field to set" | |`tag` |`wf.tag`, `wf.mode` (`add` or `remove`) | |`create` |`wf.title` (filter), `wf.fields` (JSON: field name to filter) | !! Shipped actions `actions/day-strip` (Move date: six tiles rolling forward from today: Today, Tmrw, then the weekdays of +2d, +3d, +4d, then +1 wk), `actions/mute` (2 days, Mon, 1 week), `actions/open`. Mute leaves out a tile on the same day as an earlier one (Sunday: no Mon, it is Tmrw). Day-strip labels: Today, Tmrw, +1 wk, else the weekday; sub line = the date only (`0DD mmm`). Dates in hints use `ddd DD mmm`. !! Config titles written by edit mode `$:/config/rimir/work-focus/areas/`, `…/actions/`, `…/groups/`. The slug is the caption in lowercase, each run of characters outside `a-z0-9` becomes `-`, trimmed of `-`, made unique with `-2`, `-3`; an empty slug is `new`. A new group's `wf.name` is its slug, unless it starts with a name (✎ on an implicit group keeps that name). Area order is the `list` field of `$:/tags/rimir/work-focus/area`. !! Procedures and functions of `edit-engine` |!Name |!Does | |`wf-area-open(area)` |Opens the panel in edit mode on the area's tab with its card open | |`wf-area-new(tab)`, `wf-area-delete(area)`, `wf-area-move(area, before, tab)` |Area operations; `tab` blank = General | |`wf-tab-new`, `wf-tab-rename(old, new)` |Tab operations (a tab exists as long as an area names it) | |`wf-form-open` |Opens a form; reads `kind`, `target`, `item`, `area`, `preset`, `side`, and optionally `value` (the clicked tile's value), `left`, `top` (px: the form sits there, next to the ring) | |`wf-tile-add(v)`, `wf-tile-remove(v)`, `wf-tile-move(v, by)`, `wf-tile-relabel(v, label)`, `wf-tiles-start` |The tiles editor on the buffer: `wf.tiles` stays a list of `[[value]]` tokens, or keeps the `[function[wf.distinct-days],[…]]` wrapper (as long as no value has a space) | |`wf.tiles-mode(t)`, `wf.tiles-values(t)` |`blank`, `list` (only `[[value]]` tokens or bare words), `days` (the distinct-days wrapper) or `filter`; the values of a list | |`wf-form-save`, `wf-form-duplicate`, `wf-form-delete`, `wf-form-close` |Form actions on the buffer | |`wf-escape` |Esc order: menu, form, pinned ring, open card, edit mode, panel | |`wf.tagged(tag)`, `wf.actions-all`, `wf.groups-all`, `wf.recipes-all` |Tag lists without the form buffer: use these, not a bare `tag[]` filter | |`wf.slug(text)`, `wf.config-title(prefix, caption)` |Slug and the next free config title | !! `<$wf-live>` `<$wf-live filter=… source=… delay="300" limit="3">` evaluates the filter at render and, after a pause of `delay` ms (default 300), when `filter` or `source` changes. Children see `live-count`, `live-titles`, `live-error` and `live-pending`. Other wiki changes only refresh the children. It is the only place where an area filter runs while you type. !! Recipe form `/form`: wikitext rendered in the action form with `currentTiddler` = the buffer and the variables `item`, `area`, `date-field`; it edits the `wf.*` fields of the buffer. No form tiddler: "This recipe has no settings." !! Date expressions `today`, `+Nd`, `-Nd`, `+Nw`, `mon` … `sun` (the next such day, never today), `YYYYMMDD`. !! Filter operators |!Operator |!Result | |`[wf-date[],[]]` |One date string in the shape of the sample | |`[wf-days[]]` |Whole days from today per input; blank and non-dates dropped | !! Info parts (tag `$:/tags/rimir/work-focus/info-part`) `wf.name` is the token in `wf.info`; the text is wikitext with `item`, `area`, `date-field`, `param` (the part after `:`). |!Shipped |!Shows | |`date-relative` |The area's date field relative to today (`wf.when-*` wording) | |`date-relative:` |That field instead, with `wf.when-*.` wording | |`modified-ago` |"changed 3d ago" | |`field:` |The field's value; a tiddler (or a title list) by caption | "},"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/doc/tw-internals":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/doc/tw-internals","created":"20261106120000000","modified":"20261106120000000","rdt.hub-category":"tools","rdt.hub-category-name":"Tools","rdt.hub-order":"5","rdt.order":"7","rdt.plugin-key":"work-focus","rdt.plugin-name":"work focus","rdt.plugin-subtitle":"Dock with attention counts and a drag action ring","rdt.section":"TW Internals","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template/templates/page"> <$fill $name="body"> !! Why it is built this way * ''Snapshot, not live filters.'' A live filter in the panel would re-run on every keystroke. Areas run in JS (`check.js`) at set moments and the wikitext reads one JSON tiddler. * ''First match in JS.'' "An item is in the first area that matches" is a set operation over many filters; it is simple in a loop and awkward in wikitext. * ''The ring is plain DOM.'' It is created and removed around one pointer gesture. TW's widget refresh would re-render under the pointer. Only the tile data is computed from wiki tiddlers. * ''Action strings run through `invokeActionString`'' in a small widget tree carrying the variables, with `\import` of the engine so hints and marks can use `wf.*` functions. * ''Live count, one exception.'' `<$wf-live>` is a widget that ignores wiki changes: it evaluates at render and once per 300 ms pause while the filter text changes. A plain `<$list>` would re-run the filter on every keystroke. * ''Forms edit a buffer.'' Saving uses `$action-createtiddler $basetitle=… $template=… $overwrite="yes"`, which replaces the whole tiddler; closing the form deletes only the buffer. * ''Datalist by focus.'' `<$edit-text>` cannot set an input's `list` attribute, so `datalist.js` adds it on `focusin`. !! Things worth knowing * `wf-days` and `wf-date` work on local calendar days. Evaluate `filter` under `widget` (its variables are visible). `source` (optional title) makes // the input [source]. Returns {count, titles (first `limit`), error}. A blank filter is empty; // a thrown error or a "Filter error: ..." result gives count 0 and the message (check.runFilter). exports.evaluate = function(wiki, filter, widget, source, limit) { var empty = {count: 0, titles: [], error: ""}; if(!filter || !String(filter).trim()) { return empty; } var input = source ? wiki.makeTiddlerIterator([source]) : undefined; var result = check.runFilter(wiki, filter, widget, input); if(result.error) { empty.error = result.error; return empty; } var max = parseInt(limit, 10); return { count: result.list.length, titles: isNaN(max) ? result.list.slice() : result.list.slice(0, Math.max(max, 0)), error: "" }; }; // Timer hook for the live widget (specs replace it: module code runs in TW's sandbox, // so jasmine's mock clock can't reach setTimeout) exports.timers = { set: function(fn, ms) { return setTimeout(fn, ms); }, clear: function(id) { clearTimeout(id); } }; ","type":"application/javascript","module-type":"library"},"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/live-widget.js":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/live-widget.js","text":"/*\ title: $:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/live-widget.js type: application/javascript module-type: widget <$wf-live filter=… source=… delay="300" limit="3">children</$wf-live> Debounced live filter. Children see live-count, live-titles ([[ ]]-quoted title list), live-error and live-pending (yes while a change waits for its pause). The filter runs once at render; when `filter` or `source` changes it runs again `delay` ms after the last change. Any other wiki change only refreshes the children, the filter is not re-run. \*/ "use strict"; var Widget = require("$:/core/modules/widgets/widget.js").widget; var DEFAULT_DELAY = 300, DEFAULT_LIMIT = 3; var LiveWidget = function(parseTreeNode, options) { this.initialise(parseTreeNode, options); this.timer = null; this.result = null; }; LiveWidget.prototype = Object.create(Widget.prototype); // looked up at call time so specs can spy on it / swap the timers function lib() { return require("$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/live-filter.js"); } LiveWidget.prototype.evaluate = function() { this.result = lib().evaluate(this.wiki, this.filter, this, this.source, this.limit); }; LiveWidget.prototype.readAttributes = function() { this.filter = this.getAttribute("filter", ""); this.source = this.getAttribute("source", ""); var delay = parseInt(this.getAttribute("delay", ""), 10); this.delay = isNaN(delay) || delay < 0 ? DEFAULT_DELAY : delay; var limit = parseInt(this.getAttribute("limit", ""), 10); this.limit = isNaN(limit) ? DEFAULT_LIMIT : limit; }; LiveWidget.prototype.render = function(parent, nextSibling) { this.parentDomNode = parent; this.computeAttributes(); this.readAttributes(); if(!this.result) { this.evaluate(); } this.execute(); this.renderChildren(parent, nextSibling); }; LiveWidget.prototype.execute = function() { var result = this.result || {count: 0, titles: [], error: ""}; this.setVariable("live-count", String(result.count)); this.setVariable("live-titles", $tw.utils.stringifyList(result.titles)); this.setVariable("live-error", result.error); this.setVariable("live-pending", this.timer ? "yes" : "no"); this.makeChildWidgets(); }; LiveWidget.prototype.rebuild = function() { // not removeChildDomNodes(): that destroys this widget (and its timer) too $tw.utils.each(this.children, function(child) { child.removeChildDomNodes(); }); this.children = []; this.execute(); this.renderChildren(this.parentDomNode, this.findNextSiblingDomNode()); }; LiveWidget.prototype.refresh = function(changedTiddlers) { var oldFilter = this.filter, oldSource = this.source; var changed = this.computeAttributes(); this.readAttributes(); if(this.filter !== oldFilter || this.source !== oldSource) { var self = this; if(this.timer) { lib().timers.clear(this.timer); } this.timer = lib().timers.set(function() { self.timer = null; self.evaluate(); self.rebuild(); }, this.delay); this.rebuild(); return true; } if(Object.keys(changed).length) { // delay or limit changed: nothing to re-run, children read the stored result this.rebuild(); return true; } return this.refreshChildren(changedTiddlers); }; LiveWidget.prototype.destroy = function(options) { if(this.timer) { lib().timers.clear(this.timer); this.timer = null; } Widget.prototype.destroy.call(this, options); }; exports["wf-live"] = LiveWidget; ","type":"application/javascript","module-type":"widget"},"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/notification":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/notification","text":"<$text text=<<message>>/> "},"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/panel":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/panel","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"\whitespace trim \procedure wf-edit-click() <<wf-edit-toggle>> <<wf-focus-panel>> \end <!-- Open panel: rendered only while $:/temp/rimir/work-focus/open is yes; renders only snapshot titles. Work focus A small dock in a corner of the page shows how many things need you: overdue, due today, newly started. Open it to see the items. Drag one to the side and a ring of action tiles appears; release on a tile to act on the item without opening it. !! Features * ''Dock'' — a pill strip with one count per area (alert, warning, hint). It refreshes on reload, on ↻, after an action and when an edit is saved (closing an area card, leaving edit mode, the Save of a form), never while you type. * ''Panel'' — click the dock to list the items by area, with tabs, "+ N more", and info lines such as "overdue 3d" or "changed 2d ago". * ''Areas are your filters'' — an area is a config tiddler with a filter; first match wins, so an item shows in one area only. * ''Drag ring'' — drag a row to the right: a half ring of groups (Move, Mute, Status, Open, …) opens; hover a group to fan out its tiles (Today, Tmrw, the next weekdays, +1 wk); release to run. * ''Acted marks'' — an item you acted on stays in the panel with a mark ("→ Mon 9") until the next check. * ''Mutes'' — hide an item until a day; it shows again then. Unmute from the panel footer. * ''Recipes'' — an action is a config tiddler: pick a recipe (move a date, set a field, tag, create, open, mute) or write your own action string. * ''Edit mode'' — press ✎ in the panel header: area cards with a live match count, tabs, drag reorder; forms for actions and groups, also from the ring (drag in edit mode: ✎ on a tile; the form opens next to it) and from the settings tab. An action's tiles (e.g. the days of Move) are chips in its form: add, remove, reorder, rename. * ''Generic'' — no hard dependency on any other plugin; the example areas live in your wiki, not in the plugin. !! Prerequisites * TiddlyWiki 5.4.0 or later (JS modules: server restart or reload needed after install) * Optional: `rimir/theme` (`rr-` styles in settings), `rimir/doc-template` (branded docs) !! Quick Start # Install the plugin and restart the server: its JS modules (check, ring, date operators, `live-filter.js`, `live-widget.js`, `datalist.js`) load only at startup. A single-file wiki: save and reload. # Create an area tiddler, tagged `$:/tags/rimir/work-focus/area`, with fields `caption: Overdue`, `wf.level: alert`, `wf.date-field: due-date`, `wf.info: date-relative` and the filter `wf.filter: [has[due-date]!has[completed-date]] :filter[get[due-date]wf-days[]compare:integer:lt[0]]`. # Reload the page. The dock shows a red pill with the number of overdue items (no pill when nothing is overdue). Click it to see the items. # Press on a row, drag to the right, hover //Move//, release on //Tmrw//. # Press ✎ in the panel header to edit areas, actions and groups without writing tiddlers. Esc leaves edit mode. Angles: 0 = straight out of the panel edge, positive = downwards; `dir` is +1 when the ring opens to the right of the edge, -1 to the left. A frame is {cx, cy, dir, vw, vh}. Rules every layout keeps when it can (and the tests check): * tiles are sized as hot (scaled) tiles, so even the hot tile stays clear * no tile sticks out of the viewport (MARGIN) * no tile reaches behind the edge line through the centre (i.e. over the panel) * neighbours on an arc do not overlap: they are packed along the chord with a gap \*/ "use strict"; var INNER_RADIUS = 125, ARC_STEP = 100, HOT_SCALE = 1.12, MARGIN = 8, GAPS = [14, 10, 6], // inner ring: preferred gap first, the radius grows before the gap shrinks INNER_TIERS = [{gap: 14, max: 165}, {gap: 10, max: 205}, {gap: 6, max: 245}], RADIUS_STEP = 10, ROTATE_STEP = 2 * Math.PI / 180, ROTATE_MAX = 90 * Math.PI / 180, // outer arcs may move out this far (in steps) when rotating and tighter gaps don't fit ARC_GROW = [0, 20, 40, 60], // vertical room kept around the centre (share of the first outer radius), so a fan near // the top or bottom has a sweep to turn into ROOM = 0.6, SIZE = {group: {w: 76, h: 52}, action: {w: 64, h: 44}}; exports.INNER_RADIUS = INNER_RADIUS; exports.ARC_STEP = ARC_STEP; exports.HOT_SCALE = HOT_SCALE; exports.MARGIN = MARGIN; exports.SIZE = SIZE; function half(rec) { return {w: rec.w * HOT_SCALE / 2, h: rec.h * HOT_SCALE / 2}; } // Extent of a (hot) tile projected on the tangent at angle a function along(rec, a) { return (Math.abs(Math.cos(a)) * rec.h + Math.abs(Math.sin(a)) * rec.w) * HOT_SCALE; } // Angles for recs on radius r, centred on `centre`. Neighbours are separated along the // chord between them (a separating axis), so they never overlap. function pack(recs, r, centre, gap) { function step(i, at) { var need = along(recs[i - 1], at) / 2 + along(recs[i], at) / 2 + gap; return 2 * Math.asin(Math.min(1, need / (2 * r))); } function from(start) { var angles = [start]; for(var i = 1; i < recs.length; i++) { var prev = angles[i - 1], guess = step(i, prev); // the chord axis lies at the middle angle: measure there (twice, it converges fast) guess = step(i, prev + guess / 2); angles.push(prev + Math.max(guess, step(i, prev + guess / 2))); } return angles; } var first = from(centre); return from(centre - (first[first.length - 1] - first[0]) / 2); } function place(frame, a, r) { return {x: frame.cx + frame.dir * r * Math.cos(a), y: frame.cy + r * Math.sin(a)}; } // How far a tile at angle a reaches behind the edge line (over the panel), in pixels function behind(rec, a, r) { return Math.max(0, half(rec).w - r * Math.cos(a)); } // Pixels a tile sticks out of the viewport or behind the edge (0 = fine) function violation(frame, rec, a, r) { var p = place(frame, a, r), h = half(rec); return Math.max(0, MARGIN - (p.x - h.w)) + Math.max(0, p.x + h.w - (frame.vw - MARGIN)) + Math.max(0, MARGIN - (p.y - h.h)) + Math.max(0, p.y + h.h - (frame.vh - MARGIN)) + behind(rec, a, r) * 10; } function score(frame, recs, angles, r) { return angles.reduce(function(sum, a, i) { return sum + violation(frame, recs[i], a, r); }, 0); } // Vertical reach of an arc around its centre: [top offset, bottom offset] function span(recs, angles, r) { var top = Infinity, bottom = -Infinity; angles.forEach(function(a, i) { var h = half(recs[i]).h; top = Math.min(top, r * Math.sin(a) - h); bottom = Math.max(bottom, r * Math.sin(a) + h); }); return {top: top, bottom: bottom}; } // The inner ring, laid out once at drag start. `edge` = {x, dir} (panel edge and the free // side), `rowY` the source row's centre, `levels` the deepest arc level that can open. // Picks radius and gap so all groups fit beside the edge without overlap, then moves the // centre (horizontally on narrow screens, vertically near the top or bottom) so the inner // ring is inside the viewport. Returns {frame, radius, angles, ok}. exports.inner = function(recs, view, edge, rowY, levels) { var vh = view.vh, choice = null; for(var t = 0; t < INNER_TIERS.length && !choice; t++) { for(var r = INNER_RADIUS; r <= INNER_TIERS[t].max && !choice; r += RADIUS_STEP) { var angles = pack(recs, r, 0, INNER_TIERS[t].gap), s = span(recs, angles, r), clear = angles.every(function(a, i) { return behind(recs[i], a, r) === 0; }); if(clear && s.bottom - s.top <= vh - 2 * MARGIN) { choice = {radius: r, angles: angles, span: s, ok: true}; } } } if(!choice) { // too short a viewport: tightest ring, tiles get clamped by the caller var rr = INNER_TIERS[INNER_TIERS.length - 1].max, aa = pack(recs, rr, 0, GAPS[GAPS.length - 1]); choice = {radius: rr, angles: aa, span: span(recs, aa, rr), ok: false}; } var reach = choice.radius + ARC_STEP * levels + SIZE.group.w * HOT_SCALE / 2 + MARGIN, dir = edge.dir, cx = dir > 0 ? Math.min(edge.x, view.vw - reach) : Math.max(edge.x, reach), room = ROOM * (choice.radius + ARC_STEP), top = Math.min(choice.span.top, -room), bottom = Math.max(choice.span.bottom, room), cy = bottom - top <= vh - 2 * MARGIN ? Math.max(MARGIN - top, Math.min(vh - MARGIN - bottom, rowY)) : Math.max(MARGIN - choice.span.top, Math.min(vh - MARGIN - choice.span.bottom, rowY)); // first group (the most used) nearest to the row: when the centre had to move up, away // from a row near the bottom, the order runs bottom to top (groups share one size, so the // mirrored angles keep the packing) var angles = cy < rowY - 0.5 ? choice.angles.slice().reverse() : choice.angles; return {frame: {cx: cx, cy: cy, dir: dir, vw: view.vw, vh: vh}, radius: choice.radius, reach: reach, angles: angles, ok: choice.ok}; }; // An outer arc of `recs` on radius `base` around `centre` (the owner's angle): rotate the // sweep, smallest turn first, with the preferred gap; then with smaller gaps; then a little // further out. Returns {angles, radius, ok}; when nothing fits, the best try (the caller clamps). exports.arc = function(frame, recs, base, centre) { var best = null; for(var k = 0; k < ARC_GROW.length; k++) { var r = base + ARC_GROW[k]; for(var g = 0; g < GAPS.length; g++) { for(var turn = 0; turn <= ROTATE_MAX + 1e-9; turn += ROTATE_STEP) { var tries = turn ? [turn, -turn] : [0]; for(var t = 0; t < tries.length; t++) { var angles = pack(recs, r, centre + tries[t], GAPS[g]), s = score(frame, recs, angles, r); if(s === 0) { return {angles: angles, radius: r, ok: true}; } if(!best || s < best.score) { best = {angles: angles, radius: r, score: s}; } } } } } return {angles: best.angles, radius: best.radius, ok: false}; }; // Centre of a tile at angle a, clamped into the viewport exports.position = function(frame, rec, a, r) { var p = place(frame, a, r), h = half(rec); return { x: Math.max(MARGIN + h.w, Math.min(frame.vw - MARGIN - h.w, p.x)), y: Math.max(MARGIN + h.h, Math.min(frame.vh - MARGIN - h.h, p.y)) }; }; exports.place = place; exports.pack = pack; ","type":"application/javascript","module-type":"library"},"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/ring-layer.js":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/ring-layer.js","text":"/*\ title: $:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/ring-layer.js type: application/javascript module-type: widget <$wf-ring-layer> wraps the work-focus layer and owns the drag gesture of the panel rows. * idle it has exactly one listener: `pointerdown` on its host (delegated to `.wf-item`) * a press adds move/up/cancel/key listeners on the document and blur on the window; the release removes them. Losing the window (blur, alt-tab) cancels: no pointerup may follow * moving past DRAG_THRESHOLD (mouse, pen) or holding LONG_PRESS (touch) starts the drag: actions.select() decides the ring; nothing selected → the drag is dead, no ring * the ring is a half ring on the panel edge facing the larger free space, centred on the source row: groups on the inner ring, a hovered group fans its tiles and sub-groups out on the next arc after FAN_DELAY; every arc is laid out once when it opens (ring-geometry.js: inside the viewport, clear of the panel, no overlaps), so nothing moves under the pointer * releasing on an action tile runs it, on a group runs its default tile; elsewhere or Esc cancels. The ring is removed first; the panel re-renders from the new snapshot by the normal TW refresh. The click that follows a drag is eaten (capture phase on window, so click-outside.js does not close the panel and nothing underneath is clicked) Tiles are plain DOM built from the Tile/Group data of actions.js, not wikitext. Edit mode ($:/temp/rimir/work-focus/edit = yes; mockup dock-v4 part 2): * the drag selects with {edit: true} (hidden actions and groups dimmed, empty groups too); every group fans; tiles carry ✎, the inner ring ends in "+ group", the arc of a real group ends in "+ add…" (a small menu: action / sub-group) * releasing anywhere pins the ring instead of running anything (the click is still eaten). While pinned the gesture listeners are gone; hover works through the tiles' own pointerenter/leave, clicks open forms (wf-form-open in edit-engine) or arcs, and only two document listeners exist: Esc and a pointerdown outside ring, form and panel close it. Leaving edit mode or closing the panel closes it too (refresh) * a change to an action, group or recipe tiddler (or one the ring shows) rebuilds the ring in place: same frame, the same arcs reopened by group name \*/ "use strict"; var Widget = require("$:/core/modules/widgets/widget.js").widget; var actions = require("$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/actions.js"); var geometry = require("$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/ring-geometry.js"); var DRAG_THRESHOLD = 5, LONG_PRESS = 400, FAN_DELAY = 150, CLICK_EAT_MS = 400, ARC_STEP = geometry.ARC_STEP, MARGIN = geometry.MARGIN, SIZE = geometry.SIZE, HOT_SCALE = geometry.HOT_SCALE, // the form beside a pinned ring (form.tid .wf-form width; gap to the arcs and the window) FORM_WIDTH = 340, FORM_GAP = 16, FORM_MIN_HEIGHT = 420, SVG_NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", EDIT = "$:/temp/rimir/work-focus/edit", OPEN = "$:/temp/rimir/work-focus/open", FORM = "$:/temp/rimir/work-focus/form", // dock, panel and form state (incl. the form buffer): never a reason to rebuild the pinned ring STATE_PREFIX = "$:/temp/rimir/work-focus/", CONFIG_TAGS = [actions.ACTION_TAG, actions.GROUP_TAG, actions.RECIPE_TAG]; var RingLayerWidget = function(parseTreeNode, options) { this.initialise(parseTreeNode, options); }; RingLayerWidget.prototype = Object.create(Widget.prototype); RingLayerWidget.prototype.render = function(parent, nextSibling) { this.parentDomNode = parent; this.computeAttributes(); this.execute(); var host = this.document.createElement("div"); host.className = "wf-ring-host"; parent.insertBefore(host, nextSibling); this.renderChildren(host, null); this.domNodes.push(host); this.host = host; this.listeners = []; if($tw.browser && host.addEventListener) { this.onDown = this.onPointerDown.bind(this); host.addEventListener("pointerdown", this.onDown); } }; RingLayerWidget.prototype.refresh = function(changedTiddlers) { var changed = this.refreshChildren(changedTiddlers); if(this.ring && this.ring.pinned) { this.refreshPinned(changedTiddlers); } // A refresh during a drag may re-render panel or rows: put the drag marks back if(this.ring) { this.markPanel(true); } return changed; }; RingLayerWidget.prototype.destroy = function(options) { if(this.onDown) { this.host.removeEventListener("pointerdown", this.onDown); } this.end(); Widget.prototype.destroy.call(this, options); }; // ---------- listeners (only while pressed) ---------- RingLayerWidget.prototype.listen = function(target, type, handler, options) { target.addEventListener(type, handler, options || false); this.listeners.push([target, type, handler, options || false]); }; RingLayerWidget.prototype.unlisten = function() { this.listeners.forEach(function(l) { l[0].removeEventListener(l[1], l[2], l[3]); }); this.listeners = []; }; function prevent(event) { event.preventDefault(); } // ---------- gesture ---------- RingLayerWidget.prototype.onPointerDown = function(event) { if(this.press || (event.pointerType === "mouse" && event.button !== 0)) { return; } var row = event.target && event.target.closest && event.target.closest(".wf-item[data-wf-item]"); if(!row) { return; } if(this.ring) { // a pinned ring (edit mode) gives way to a press on a row this.end(); } var self = this, doc = this.document; this.press = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY, pointerId: event.pointerId, touch: event.pointerType === "touch", item: row.getAttribute("data-wf-item"), area: row.getAttribute("data-wf-area") || "", label: (row.querySelector(".wf-item-label") || row).textContent, started: false, dead: false, timer: null }; this.listen(doc, "pointermove", function(e) { self.onPointerMove(e); }); this.listen(doc, "pointerup", function(e) { self.onPointerUp(e); }); this.listen(doc, "pointercancel", function(e) { if(e.pointerId === self.press.pointerId) { self.end(); } }); this.listen(doc, "keydown", function(e) { self.onKeyDown(e); }, true); this.listen(doc.defaultView, "blur", function() { self.end(); }); if(this.press.touch) { // long press starts the drag; the system menu of a long press is suppressed this.listen(doc, "contextmenu", prevent, true); this.press.timer = setTimeout(function() { self.start(self.press.x, self.press.y); }, LONG_PRESS); } }; RingLayerWidget.prototype.onPointerMove = function(event) { var press = this.press; if(event.pointerId !== press.pointerId) { return; } if(!press.started) { if(Math.abs(event.clientX - press.x) + Math.abs(event.clientY - press.y) <= DRAG_THRESHOLD) { return; } if(press.touch) { // moved before the long press: a scroll, not a drag this.end(); return; } this.start(event.clientX, event.clientY); } if(this.ring) { this.track(event.clientX, event.clientY); } }; RingLayerWidget.prototype.onPointerUp = function(event) { var press = this.press; if(event.pointerId !== press.pointerId) { return; } if(!press.started) { // a plain click: let it through to the row (navigates) this.end(); return; } if(this.ring && this.ring.edit) { // edit mode: the release pins the ring, nothing runs this.eatClick(); this.pin(); return; } var rec = this.ring ? this.hit(event.clientX, event.clientY) : null, tile = rec && (rec.kind === "action" ? rec.data : rec.data.defaultTile); this.end(); this.eatClick(); if(tile) { actions.run(this, tile, press.item, press.area); } }; RingLayerWidget.prototype.onKeyDown = function(event) { if(event.key !== "Escape") { return; } // cancel the drag, keep the panel open; the release then only eats its click event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); clearTimeout(this.press.timer); this.press.started = true; this.press.dead = true; this.removeRing(); }; RingLayerWidget.prototype.start = function(x, y) { var press = this.press, groups = [], edit = this.wiki.getTiddlerText(EDIT) === "yes"; clearTimeout(press.timer); press.started = true; try { groups = edit ? actions.select(this.wiki, press.item, press.area, {edit: true}).groups : actions.select(this.wiki, press.item, press.area).groups; } catch(e) { groups = []; } // edit mode shows a ring even without groups: it still has "+ group" if((!groups.length && !edit) || !this.buildRing(groups, edit)) { press.dead = true; return; } if(press.touch) { // keep the page from scrolling while a finger drags this.listen(this.document, "touchmove", prevent, {passive: false}); } this.track(x, y); }; // Remove ring, marks and every listener; the widget is idle again RingLayerWidget.prototype.end = function() { if(this.press) { clearTimeout(this.press.timer); } this.removeRing(); this.unlisten(); this.press = null; }; // The click that follows a drag: eaten before click-outside.js or the row see it RingLayerWidget.prototype.eatClick = function() { var win = this.document.defaultView, timer; function eat(event) { event.stopPropagation(); event.preventDefault(); done(); } function done() { clearTimeout(timer); win.removeEventListener("click", eat, true); } win.addEventListener("click", eat, true);
